from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSReport(BaseModel):
    """EPS data extracted from one company's financial filing for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The EPS amount for the period, positive for income, negative for loss")
    eps_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Income per common share, basic' or 'Net loss per common share, basic')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the EPS covers (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    weighted_avg_shares_outstanding: float | None = Field(description="Weighted average shares outstanding if disclosed")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_reports: list[CompanyEPSReport]
